system.description:
[Trigger: Immediately After Damage] Used when you take damage from a target within "Range: 2Sq". Gives the target [Decay:5]. This [Decay] does not overwrite existing [Decay] on the target, but instead adds to its intensity. A whip made by intertwining multiple silver chains and infused with a bramble curse. It wraps around anyone who seeks to harm its user, as if possessing will of its own, and retaliates by thrusting cursed thorns.

Cacti Thorns [Core Material] (140G) + Chain Whip (100G) × 3 + [Magic Catalyst 8] (70G) × 2 + Crafting Cost (300G)
